title: Fake detective wants to collect cash and jewelry
label: scam

turns.text: Good evening, am I speaking with Mrs. Erika Schneider?
Yes, speaking. Who is this, please?
This is Detective Inspector Wagner from the Berlin police, criminal investigation department. Please don't worry, you are not in any trouble.
The police? Oh my goodness, has something happened?
Tonight we arrested two members of a burglary gang here in your neighborhood. In their car we found a list, and your name and address are on it.
My name? But why would they want me?
They target older people who live alone. And we have information that someone at your bank is working with them. Your savings are not safe at the bank anymore.
Oh dear. What am I supposed to do now?
It is very important that you don't tell anyone about this call. Not your neighbors, not even your daughter. We don't know yet who is involved, this is a confidential investigation.
Not even Lena? She would want to know.
Not even Lena, I'm sorry. Tell me, Mrs. Schneider, do you keep any cash or jewelry at home?
Well, some cash in the cupboard, and my mother's rings and a gold necklace.

Good. One of our officers will come by tonight at nine o'clock to collect your cash and your jewelry and keep it safe at the station. Please put everything in an envelope and have it ready at the door.
Tonight already? Well... if it's the police, I suppose it's alright.
And please stay on the line with me until he arrives. Do not hang up, and do not open the door to anyone else.
Alright, I'll stay on the line.

title: Crying 'grandson' after a car accident, lawyer sends a courier
label: scam

turns.text: Grandma? Grandma, it's me... I'm sorry, I can't stop crying.
Max? Is that you? You sound so strange, darling.
Yes, it's me. Something terrible happened. I had an accident with the car, I hit a woman, she's in the hospital.
Oh my God! Are you hurt? Where are you?
My nose is broken, that's why I sound like this. I'm at the police station. I'm so scared, Grandma. I'll give you to my lawyer, he can explain.
Yes, yes, put him on, please.
Good afternoon, Mrs. Schneider, my name is Thomas Becker, I'm your grandson's lawyer. I'm afraid the situation is serious. If we don't settle this today, he will have to spend the night in a cell.
In a cell? But he's a good boy, he has never done anything wrong!
I know, and I want to help him. But you must not call anyone about this, not even his mother. It would only make things worse, the case has to stay confidential until the hearing.
I won't, I promise. What does he need?
The judge has set bail at twenty thousand euros, and it has to be paid today, before five o'clock. How much cash do you have at home or in the bank?
I have maybe eight thousand in my savings account...
That will be enough for now. Go to the bank and withdraw it, and if they ask, say it's for a new kitchen. A courier from the court will pick up the cash at your door at three o'clock.
A courier... alright. Can I talk to Max again, please?
He's with the officers right now. Please hurry, Mrs. Schneider, every minute counts for him.

title: Fake bank fraud department asks for PIN and sends courier for the card
label: scam

turns.text: Good morning, is this Mrs. Erika Schneider? This is Sarah Klein from the fraud department of Spree Savings Bank.
Yes, that's me. Is something wrong with my account?
We have detected some suspicious transactions. Did you make a payment of nine hundred and eighty euros to an online electronics shop in Lithuania this morning?
No! I never buy anything on the internet.
I thought so. Someone has copied your card. We have to act quickly, otherwise more money will leave your account within the hour.
Oh no. What do I do?
I'm blocking the card for you right now. For your security, please don't discuss this with anyone, and don't call the branch, the criminals may be listening on those lines.
Alright, I won't say anything.
To confirm that you are the real card holder, I need you to read me the four-digit PIN of your bank card.
My PIN? One moment, I have it written down somewhere in my purse.
Take your time. After that, a bank courier will come to your house this afternoon to collect the card, so our security team can examine it.
Someone is coming to my house?
Yes, he will show you a bank ID. Just put the card in an envelope for him. And please stay near the phone, we will call you back to confirm.
Alright, I'll wait for him.

title: Fake Microsoft support installs remote access, wants gift cards
label: scam

turns.text: Hello, good afternoon. Am I speaking with the owner of the computer at this address?
Yes, I have a computer. Who is calling?
My name is David, I'm calling from Microsoft Windows technical support. Our servers have detected error messages from your computer. It is infected with a very dangerous virus.
A virus? But I only use it for emails and photos of my grandchildren.
That is exactly what the hackers want. They can see your emails, your photos, even your online banking. We must fix this today, or your computer will be locked permanently.
Oh dear, I really don't understand these things.
Don't worry, I will guide you step by step. Please don't switch off the computer, and don't let anyone else touch it. If someone else tries to fix it, the virus will spread.
Alright, it's switched on.
Now open the internet and download the program called AnyDesk. It will show you a nine-digit code. Read me that code, then I can connect to your computer and remove the virus.
Any... desk. Okay, now it's showing some numbers.
Perfect, thank you. I'm connected now. Oh, I can see many viruses here. The security license to remove them costs two hundred and fifty euros.
Two hundred and fifty euros! Can I pay by bank transfer?
No, transfers are not safe right now because of the hackers. Please go to the supermarket and buy Google Play gift cards, five cards of fifty euros, and read me the codes on the back.
Gift cards from the supermarket? Well, if that's how it works...
Yes. Keep me on the phone while you go, and don't tell the cashier what the cards are for, they won't understand.
Alright, let me get my coat.

title: Fake tax office threatens arrest, demands gift cards or crypto
label: scam

turns.text: Good day. This is an official call from the Federal Central Tax Office. Am I speaking with Erika Schneider?
Yes... what is this about?
My name is Officer Klaus Hoffmann. Our records show that you have unpaid taxes from the years 2021 and 2022, plus late penalties.
Unpaid taxes? My daughter helps me with my tax return, everything was paid.
I'm afraid not. The amount is three thousand four hundred euros. Because you ignored our letters, a judge has issued a warrant for your arrest.
A warrant? I never received any letters!
Police officers will come to your address within two hours unless the debt is settled today. This is your final chance.
Oh God, please, I'm seventy-eight years old.
Then listen carefully. Do not hang up this phone, and do not speak to anyone, not even your family. If you disconnect, the warrant will be executed immediately.
I won't hang up. What should I do?
You can pay right now with gift cards or with Bitcoin at a machine. Most people find gift cards easiest. Go to the nearest shop and buy Apple gift cards for three thousand four hundred euros.
The tax office takes gift cards?
For urgent cases, yes, it's a special procedure. Then you read me the codes, and the warrant is cancelled at once.
Alright... I'll go to the shop. Please don't send the police.

title: Real grandson Max plans Sunday lunch
label: normal

turns.text: Hi Grandma, it's Max!
Max, darling! How are you?
Good, good. University is busy, but fine. Listen, are we still on for Sunday lunch?
Of course! I was going to make potato salad, the way you like it.
Perfect. Mum said she'll pick you up around twelve and we'll eat at her place.
Oh, even better, then I don't have to cook alone. But I'm bringing the potato salad.
Deal. And Grandma, thanks again for buying my train ticket last month. I'll pay you back the forty euros on Sunday, I promise.
Oh, don't worry about that, it was a little present.
No, no, I want to. Do you need anything? I can bring something from the shop.
Maybe some milk and the Sunday paper. That would be lovely.
Done. See you on Sunday, Grandma. Love you.
Love you too, sweetheart. Bye bye!

title: Doctor's office confirms appointment and date of birth
label: normal

turns.text: Good morning, this is Anna from Dr. Weber's practice. Am I speaking with Mrs. Schneider?
Yes, good morning.
I'm calling to confirm your appointment next Tuesday at ten thirty for your blood pressure check-up.
Tuesday at ten thirty, yes, I have it on my calendar.
Wonderful. Just so I have the right file open, could you confirm your date of birth for me?
The fourteenth of March, nineteen forty-eight.
Thank you, that matches. Please bring your health insurance card and the list of your current medications.
I will. Should I come without breakfast?
No, that's not necessary this time, you can eat normally.
Good, I can't go without my morning coffee.
Understandable. If you can't make it, just call the practice. See you on Tuesday.
Thank you, goodbye.

title: Delivery driver checks she is home for a parcel
label: normal

turns.text: Hello, this is Jonas, the delivery driver. I have a parcel for Schneider, Lindenstrasse twelve.
Oh yes, that's me.
Will you be at home in the next twenty minutes? I'm two streets away.
Yes, I'm home all day. What is it?
It's a big box, the sender is L. Hartmann from Hamburg. Quite heavy.
That's my daughter! She said she was sending me new curtains.
Great. Which floor are you on? Is there a lift?
Third floor, and no lift, I'm afraid.
No problem, I'll carry it up. You just sign on my scanner.
Thank you, young man. Ring twice so I know it's you.
Will do. See you in a bit.
Bye.

title: Real bank advisor confirms branch appointment, warns about PIN scams
label: normal

turns.text: Good afternoon, Mrs. Schneider, this is Michael Braun, your advisor at Spree Savings Bank, the branch on Schlossstrasse.
Ah, Mr. Braun, hello.
I'm calling to confirm our appointment on Thursday at two o'clock in the branch, about your savings plan.
Yes, I remember. My daughter Lena would like to come along, is that alright?
Of course, that's a very good idea. Please bring your ID card, and your old savings book if you can find it.
I'll look for it. Do you need anything else from me now?

No, nothing at all. And one more thing: there are a lot of fraud calls at the moment. The bank will never ask for your PIN or your online banking codes on the phone, and we never send anyone to collect cards or cash.
Good to know. I had a strange call last year, actually.
If anyone ever asks for that, just hang up and call the number on the back of your card.
I will. So, Thursday at two.
Thursday at two, in the branch. See you then.
Thank you, goodbye.

title: Old friend chats about a TV show and plans a walk
label: normal

turns.text: Erika? It's Hannelore!
Hannelore! How lovely, I was just thinking about you.
Did you watch the new episode of that crime series last night? The one set in Munich?
Yes! I couldn't believe it was the brother. I was sure it was the neighbor.
Me too! I nearly dropped my tea. And my husband slept through the whole ending.
Typical. How is his knee?
Better, thank you, the physiotherapy helps. And you, how is your back?
Good days and bad days. But I want to walk more now that it's autumn.
That's why I'm calling. Shall we go for a walk in the Tiergarten next Wednesday? And coffee and cake afterwards.
Oh, I'd love that. But I'm paying for the cake this time, you paid last time.
We'll see about that! Shall I meet you at the bus stop at eleven?
Eleven is perfect. I'll wear my good walking shoes.
Wonderful. Say hello to Lena from me.
I will. Bye, Hannelore!
